title: Enzyme Kinetics
description: An enzyme speeds up with more substrate, but only until it is busy all the time. Michaelis and Menten wrote the curve. Unlocks the Enzyme Assay Bench.

puzzle.goal: An enzyme with top speed V and constant K is given substrate at level S. Write how fast it works, v.
puzzle.name: Michaelis-Menten
puzzle.ask: Find v for V = @{V}, S = @{S} and K = @{K}.
puzzle.method: The enzyme is busy a fraction S/(K + S) of the time (binding is quick, turnover slow): at S = K, half speed.
